description: The BigQuery adapter applies SAFE_DIVIDE through _safeguard_division_by_zero (bigquery.py:1544-1555, 2141). The fork exposes this as opt-in safe_division, off by default, reached through apply_rewrite (added in the first adoption). The adapter must pass it explicitly so behavior is unchanged before the local safeguard is deleted (the d2 item depends on this one); deleting the safeguard without enabling the option would restore zero-divisor errors. The owner also reviews whether the NULL-on-zero semantic affects published results.
